strings.en: I wonder what kind of scream you'll make?
Now, how shall I carve you up?
I'll give you plenty of loving attention!
Come on, scream for me!
Suffer plenty!
I've got time to toy with you lot!
Struggle all you like, will you?/　Just to keep me entertained!
There's only one place for you to run.../　That's right, the afterlife!
I'll slice you up, along with Fairy!
Boy, your luck ran out when you took up with her!
Fairy, I'll carve you up nice and slow!
Pay for your crimes with your life!
Come on, you and Fairy both,/　let me hear you sing!
Little girl! I'll finish you off along with Fairy!
Rebels get a bloodbath!
Sieg, I'll be the one to take your head!
Beg the Earthlings for help in that cute voice!
Coming all this way... What a stupid little girl!
Pretty boy... I'll twist that face of yours!
Now then.../　What kind of scream will you give me, boy?
Like a powder keg, aren't you? Go on, blow up!
A little too flashy. I'll paint you all red!
Red ones get special attention from me!
The redder they are, the hotter I get!
Me and this baby both love red./　It's the color of blood, after all!
Not yet! I'm not satisfied!
Too slow to get away... How stupid!
That's what you get for dawdling!
The fun's only just beginning!
No use running, wherever you go!
Don't think you'll get an easy death!
Tough luck, you!
What, you were still there?
You're telling me this baby and I lost?!
Tch, so this is as long as I can stall!
L-Lady Herluga...!!
No way! This is all backwards!
To think I'd be the one who bleeds...!
I'll make you regret it...!/　Regret not finishing me off!
I hope you're ready for what's coming!/　After going this far!
Th-This baby, pushed back this far?!
Until I've splattered your blood,/　I'm not going down!
You're telling me this is the boy's power...?!
Fairy... I'll give you the same fate as your brother!
Me, having trouble with a little girl like that...!
So you've sold everything to the Earthlings!
Brat of Anex! Don't get cocky!
Traitor, I'll squeeze out every drop of your blood!
You're telling me some Leonysis is pushing/　this baby back?!
Little girl of Anex...! That's enough out of you!
Ngh! Me, the one getting painted red?/　Don't make me laugh!
So it's not just the machine, the boy's special too?!
Fine by me! I'll smash every last one of you!
Just as the intel said... How annoying!
You've done it now!/　In return, I'll cut your life short!
Hmph, I don't like this.
I don't feel a thing from pain like this!
Ha, not bad!/　Now things are getting fun!
So you can fight smart after all.
Hahahaha! Come on, set me on fire!
Guess I'll play with you for real now...!
Want to die that badly, alongside Fairy?!
Whatever you do,/　you can't stop Lady Herluga's plan!
Sieg... Don't think you'll get an easy death.
Traitor... I'll leave you with a face no one can look at.
Boy, this is more than youthful folly now...!
That's right! If you're gonna wear red,/　you'd better do at least that much!
I'll paint you even redder... the color of blood!
So you're as good as you look!
I'll strip off that armor and rip you to shreds!
I like it!/　Combining was worth it after all!
You're getting too cocky, you piece of junk!
Smashing those goggles won't be the end of it!
Heh heh, I thought running around/　was all you were good for.
All this flitting about/　is starting to get on my nerves...!
Ha! That doesn't look like/　all the power you're hiding, does it?
Oh? Looks like something grazed me.
Not nearly enough.
What? All show, no go?
My, my, are you lot stalling too?
Come on, come on, set me on fire some more!
Oh, how scary, how scary! Ahahahaha!
Hmph, so you want to die with Fairy.
What do you think you're doing, Fairy?
Hmph, traitorous little girl.
You talked big to me,/　so I'll give you plenty of loving attention.
You're making that lovely red cry!
Looks like you want to be painted even redder.
All of you together, and that's it?
Come on, come on, I'm over here!
Go on, use that trump card of yours.
Rack that empty head of yours/　and figure out what's missing.
Boy, I'm right here!
Fairy, what did you even come here for?
That color doesn't suit small fry!
Heh heh, frustrated?
That bought me some nice time.
Something like that will never reach me!
Hmph, I'll let you off.
Looks like I overdid it.
Oh well, at least I can buy time.
You must be really scared of me.
Playing hard to get, are we?
You're first-rate at running away.
Sorry, but there's more to come!
You're sloppy at the finish, Bilgo!
No need to trouble Lady Herluga!
Quit dawdling!
Lady Herluga, fall back while you can!
Don't break on me yet, okay?
Take this!
There, there, there!
Don't die from an attack like this!
Where will it hit, I wonder!
I won't let you die easy!
Smashed or sliced, which do you prefer?
Let me hear the sound of you breaking!
No answer? Then you get both!
Yes, that's the sound!
I'll make a bloodbath of you all!
Run around all you like! Not that it'll help!!
How do you like to be cooked?
Whatever you say, the answer's already decided!
Vanish without even leaving bones!!
Space is cold, so I'll warm you up!
Bloody Blaster!
Ahhh-hahahahaha!!
Me and this baby are itching for it!
Itching to sip your blood!
Show me your blood!
Show it to me and this baby!
Come on, come on!
You're mine!
Now, I'll make a bloodbath of you!
Brace yourself!
There you go!
Bloody Cyclone!!
Finish it!
Does it hurt?! I bet it does!/　Ahahahahahaha!!
Where are you looking?!
Now, cry for me nice and loud!
And spray your blood everywhere!
Writhe!
Struggle! Suffer! Scream!!
